annotations.title: Check: the text the paying wallet signs to buy

description: Step one of buying a Check (owner, 12/11/2026: only a wallet that passes the free screening buys, so it signs first). The challenge of its own, scope buy: the text says this wallet pays for a Check and is screened before buying, valid 10 minutes, and that it moves no funds and authorizes no destination. chainId is any network check_info lists. Returns { nonce, message, expiresAt, buildId (check-buy-<nonce>), typedData (EVM) | proofTransaction (Solana) }. Sign it with prepare_signing, then call check_buy_proof.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

name: check_buy_challenge
